answer: Random peer audit catches bulk fakes at their nadir. A newcomer posts a 120 POA bond, twice 30-day earnings; a beacon picks 7 peers to audit its first tasks. A plume of mismatched evidence deepens review. Failure burns the bond and bars the identity; colluding auditors are slashed too. 100 fakes lock 12,000 POA, burn 9,600 at an 80% catch rate, earn under 1,500. Honest agents pay once, reclaim the bond and keep rewards undiluted as the tide ebbs.
